system.description:
Some Spacers may just be “a guy in a suit” and all of their abilities come from a specialized suit of power armor with weapons and features built into it.

Species Trait: Any, including Life Support. You do not require external food, drink, or air to function while connected to your Life Support. You still need to rest and your armor requires a power charge equivalent to a rest to maintain its operational level.
Archetype: Machine-Based Archetype.
Background / Motivation: Power Armor Spacers can choose any background or motivation.
The Triad: Power Armor Spacers can take The Triad as a Species Trait.
